newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kremlin confirms surgeon, venue of Yeltsin's op.
newsitem.headline: Kremlin confirms surgeon, venue of Yeltsin's op.

text.p: The Kremlin said on Monday that Russian surgeon Renat Akchurin would lead bypass surgery on President Boris Yeltsin's heart and a bulletin on the president's health would be released later in the day.

A presidential spokesman said the operation would take place at Moscow's Cardiology Research Centre. A council of doctors, including Akchurin and U.S. expert Michael DeBakey, was meeting on Monday to decide whether Yeltsin was fit for surgery, he said.
It had been widely expected that the operation would be led by Akchurin, who trained in Houston under DeBakey, the 88-year-old patriarch of heart surgery.
DeBakey said last week he expected Yeltsin's operation -- which doctors expect to be a triple bypass -- to take place early this week and the doctors' council on Monday might set a firm date.
Interfax news agency said the doctors would meet at the Barvikha country residence and sanatorium where Yeltsin has been staying for the last few weeks.
